channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump hints at possible Strait of Hormuz deal as Iran and Oman hold talks
item.description: President Trump said progress has been made on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and a deal might be announced soon.

item.title: Influencer fatally shot while livestreaming outside restaurant
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, a TikTok personality with over 600,000 followers, was killed during a live broadcast with two friends.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan primary but faces coalition-building test
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed's victory was narrower than expected, highlighting the challenge of uniting the coalition needed for the general election.

item.title: Tiger sharks spotted off New England coast
item.description: Two brothers fishing off Massachusetts caught a tiger shark, as sightings increase in Northeast waters.
